text: UMVPA M1.E2 integration under epic bd-01M2BMGRP4MSM0RRRKNTHM0H4K. Reuse as the independent neighborhood baseline for M1 frame qualification. Existing scope remains volume/surface geometry, units, support/center ordering, failure and independent reference semantics; no foreign-engine runtime shim is introduced. It can start immediately; the new measurement integration is tested in M1.11. New native prerequisites: none. Requirements FND-03, NUM-01. See docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md. This links existing work; it does not mark it implemented or qualified.
